name: dps310
identity: Barometric pressure + temperature sensor (Infineon DPS3xx family)
evidence: 0xD0 reads 0xFF and 0x80-0xFF all read 0xFF, ruling out BMP280/BME280/BMP180. Map 0x00-0x28 matches DPS310 exactly: 24-bit PSR_B2..B0 = fe 2f ee, TMP_B2..B0 = 02 69 a6, PRS_CFG=00, TMP_CFG=80 (external temp sensor), MEAS_CFG=F0 (COEF_RDY|SENSOR_RDY|TMP_RDY|PRS_RDY), CFG_REG=00, 18-byte coefficient block at 0x10-0x21, COEF_SRCE 0x28=0x90. Auto-increment wraps from 0xFF to 0x00. Product ID 0x0D reads 0xFF (not 0x10), so DPS310 vs DPS368 is unconfirmed. Soft reset (w 0C 09) acks and status stays F0.
registers: 0x00-02 PSR 24-bit signed raw; 0x03-05 TMP 24-bit signed raw; 0x06 PRS_CFG (rate/oversampling); 0x07 TMP_CFG (bit7 external sensor, rate/oversampling); 0x08 MEAS_CFG (status bits 7-4, mode bits 2-0); 0x09 CFG_REG; 0x0C RESET (write 0x09 = soft reset); 0x0D product ID (reads 0xFF here); 0x10-0x21 coefficients c0(12) c1(12) c00(20) c10(20) c01 c11 c20 c21 c30 (16-bit signed) = 225, -291, 81061, -57006, -1594, 1233, -9401, 91, -1222; 0x28 COEF_SRCE=0x90. Auto-increment on reads. Compensation at 1x oversampling: kT=kP=524288; T=c0/2+c1*Tsc; P=c00+Psc*(c10+Psc*(c20+Psc*c30))+Tsc*c01+Tsc*Psc*(c11+Psc*c21).
by: Claude Code CLI (claude -p / agent with probe.py only)

functions.sig: static int dps310_read(unsigned addr, long *temp_mc, long *press_pa)
functions.doc: compensated temperature in milli-degC (-40000..85000) and pressure in Pa (30000..120000); triggers a 1x measurement if none is ready; 0 = ok

functions.sig: static int dps310_read_raw(unsigned addr, long *temp_raw, long *press_raw)
functions.doc: raw 24-bit signed TMP (0x03..05) and PSR (0x00..02) at 1x oversampling, scale 524288; measures first if needed; 0 = ok

functions.sig: static int dps310_compensate(unsigned addr, long temp_raw, long press_raw, long *temp_mc, long *press_pa)
functions.doc: reads the chip's coefficients 0x10..0x21 and turns 24-bit raw values into milli-degC and Pa; 0 = ok

1 if product ID 0x0D reads 0x10 (DPS310/DPS368 share it); 0 if 0x0D has another non-0xFF value, 0xD0 has a Bosch-style ID (not 0xFF) or reserved MEAS_CFG bit 3 is set; -1 if a read fails or 0x0D reads 0xFF and nothing rules it out (the bench part reads 0xFF, so it gives -1 here)

oracle.dump: fe 2f ee 02 69 a6 00 80 f0 00 ff ff ff ff ff ff 0e 1e dd 13 ca 5f 21 52 f9 c6 04 d1 db 47 00 5b fb 3a ff ff ff ff ff ff 90 ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff 02 ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff
oracle.oracle_tail:
I worked this out from the register dump and the DPS310 datasheet formulas.

**Configuration read from the dump**
- PRS_CFG (0x06) is 0x00, so pressure uses 1x oversampling and kP = 524288.
- TMP_CFG (0x07) is 0x80. That selects the external temperature sensor, with 1x oversampling and kT = 524288.
- MEAS_CFG (0x08) is 0xF0, so the coefficients, sensor, temperature and pressure flags are all ready. No new measurement is needed.
- CFG_REG (0x09) is 0x00, so no result shift is applied.

**Raw readings**
- PSR = 0xFE2FEE, which is −118802 as a signed number. Scaled: Praw_sc = −118802 / 524288 = −0.2265968
- TMP = 0x0269A6, which is 158118. Scaled: Traw_sc = 158118 / 524288 = 0.3015862

**Coefficients from 0x10..0x21** (`0e 1e dd 13 ca 5f 21 52 f9 c6 04 d1 db 47 00 5b fb 3a`)
- c0 = 225, c1 = −291
- c00 = 81061, c10 = −57006
- c01 = −1594, c11 = 1233
- c20 = −9401, c21 = 91, c30 = −1222

**Temperature**
T = c0/2 + c1·Traw_sc = 112.5 − 87.7616 = **24.7384 °C**

**Pressure**
P = c00 + Praw_sc·(c10 + Praw_sc·(c20 + Praw_sc·c30)) + Traw_sc·c01 + Traw_sc·Praw_sc·(c11 + Praw_sc·c21)

The terms work out as:
- Pressure polynomial: Praw_sc·(…) = +12448.891
- Temperature term: Traw_sc·c01 = −480.728
- Cross term: Traw_sc·Praw_sc·(…) = −82.852

P = 81061 + 12448.891 − 480.728 − 82.852 = **92946.31 Pa**, or about 929.46 hPa. Both values are inside the driver's stated ranges.
